market.regime_rules_description: Rule-based classification: Strong Bullish: NIFTY > 20&50 DMA and >70% stocks > 50 DMA. Bullish: NIFTY > 50 DMA and >50% stocks > 50 DMA. Neutral: Mixed trend and breadth indicators. Bearish: NIFTY < 50 DMA and <50% stocks > 50 DMA. Strong Bearish: NIFTY < 20&50 DMA and <30% stocks > 50 DMA.
